title: Rethinking Reasoning: A Survey on Reasoning-based Backdoors in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2510.07697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rise of advanced reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) are receiving increasing attention. However, although reasoning improves LLMs' performance on downstream tasks, it also introduces new security risks, as adversaries can exploit these capabilities to conduct backdoor attacks. Existing surveys on backdoor attacks and reasoning security offer comprehensive overviews but lack in-depth analysis of backdoor attacks and defenses targeting LLMs' reasoning abilities. In this paper, we take the first step toward providing a comprehensive review of reasoning-based backdoor attacks in LLMs by analyzing their underlying mechanisms, methodological frameworks, and unresolved challenges. Specifically, we introduce a new taxonomy that offers a unified perspective for summarizing existing approaches, categorizing reasoning-based backdoor attacks into associative, passive, and active. translated_title: 重新思考推理：大语言模型中基于推理的后门攻击综述
translated_abstract: 随着先进推理能力的兴起，大语言模型（LLMs）受到越来越多的关注。然而，尽管推理能力提升了大语言模型在下游任务上的性能，但它也带来了新的安全风险，因为攻击者可以利用这些能力发起后门攻击。现有的关于后门攻击和推理安全的综述提供了全面的概述，但缺乏针对大语言模型推理能力的后门攻击与防御的深入分析。在本文中，我们迈出了第一步，通过分析其潜在机制、方法框架和未解决的挑战，对大语言模型中基于推理的后门攻击进行了全面综述。具体而言，我们提出了一种新的分类法，为总结现有方法提供了统一视角，将基于推理的后门攻击分为关联型、被动型和主动型三类。我们还提出了相应的防御策略……
tldr: 本文首次对大语言模型中基于推理的后门攻击进行了全面综述，提出了将攻击分为关联型、被动型和主动型三类的新分类法，并系统分析了其机制、方法框架、防御策略及未解决的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of reasoning-based backdoor attacks in LLMs, introducing a new taxonomy that categorizes attacks into associative, passive, and active types, while analyzing their mechanisms, methodological frameworks, defenses, and open challenges.
